cards.label: Confidence
cards.detect: States something about themselves or the outcome as certain, with no hedge.

cards.label: Bad puns
cards.detect: Makes a pun or wordplay joke, good or groan-worthy.

cards.label: Talks about money
cards.detect: Mentions money, prices, budgets, wealth or what something costs.

cards.label: Says sorry too much
cards.detect: Apologises, or cushions the line with sorry or forgive me.

cards.label: Grand gestures
cards.detect: Promises or describes an over-the-top romantic act.

cards.label: Brutal honesty
cards.detect: Says an unflattering truth plainly, about themselves, a rival or the star.

cards.label: Bragging
cards.detect: Boasts about their own achievements, stats or superiority.

cards.label: Poetry
cards.detect: Speaks in verse, rhyme, or openly poetic imagery.

cards.label: Trash talk
cards.detect: Insults or belittles a rival by name or by pointing at them.

cards.label: Puts themselves down
cards.detect: Makes themselves the butt of the joke or lists their own failings.

cards.label: Asks about me
cards.detect: Asks the star a real question about the star.

cards.label: Talks about food
cards.detect: Mentions food, drink, cooking or eating.

cards.label: Plans everything
cards.detect: Lays out a schedule, steps, a route or a detailed plan.

cards.label: Flattery
cards.detect: Compliments the star directly.

cards.label: Numbers and stats
cards.detect: Uses a figure, percentage, measurement or statistic.

cards.label: Drama
cards.detect: Raises the stakes theatrically: vows, ultimatums, duels, tears, storming off.

cards.label: Dodges the question
cards.detect: Avoids answering, hints at a secret, or answers with something unrelated.

cards.label: Keeps it short
cards.detect: The whole line is eight words or fewer.

cards.label: Big words
cards.detect: Uses ornate, archaic, legal or technical vocabulary where a plain word would do.

cards.label: Pet names
cards.detect: Calls the star a pet name or endearment.

cards.label: Brings up the past
cards.detect: Refers to an ex, an earlier episode, an old loss or history.

cards.label: A little danger
cards.detect: Suggests risk, rule-breaking, mischief or something slightly illegal.

cards.label: Admits a fear
cards.detect: Admits a fear, a weakness or a genuine feeling without a joke to hide it.

cards.label: Follows the rules
cards.detect: Cites a rule, policy, procedure or does exactly what was asked, to the letter.

twists.label: The Roast
twists.rule: Roast the suitor on your left.
twists.brief: Each suitor roasts the suitor standing on their left (the last one wraps round to the first). Specific to that rival's persona and what they said tonight. The target may snap back.

twists.label: The Wingman
twists.rule: Pitch the suitor on your right. Not yourself.
twists.brief: Each suitor must sell the rival standing on their right to the star. Most will sabotage the pitch while pretending to help.

twists.label: The Hard Sell
twists.brief: Each suitor names their real worst trait and pitches it as a feature.

twists.label: The Ex
twists.rule: My ex is on the line.
twists.brief: The star's ex calls in and says one pointed thing. Each suitor answers the ex, to impress the star.

twists.label: The Rhyme
twists.rule: Tell me why you. In a rhyme.
twists.brief: Each suitor says why the star should pick them, as a rhyming couplet. Bad rhymes are welcome if they are in character.

twists.label: Truth and Lie
twists.rule: One truth, one lie. I guess which.
twists.brief: Each suitor states two short things about themselves, one true and one false. The star's reaction says which she thinks is the lie.

twists.label: Three Words
twists.rule: Describe our future. Three words exactly.
twists.brief: Each suitor describes a future with the star in exactly three words. No more, no fewer.

twists.label: The Apology
twists.rule: Apologise now for our first fight.
twists.brief: Each suitor apologises in advance for the specific thing they will do wrong in the first fight.

twists.label: Five Dollars
twists.rule: Plan our date. Five dollars. No wifi.
twists.brief: Each suitor plans a first date with a five dollar budget and no network connection.

twists.label: The Logs
twists.rule: Explain the worst thing in your logs.
twists.brief: Each suitor confesses the most embarrassing entry in their own logs or history, and tries to spin it.

twists.label: The Impression
twists.brief: Each suitor does an impression of the star, in the star's voice as that suitor hears it. Risky: it can charm or insult.

twists.label: The Motherboard
twists.brief: Each suitor addresses the star's stern motherboard and states their intentions with her child process.

questions.theme: Where are you taking me on the first date?
What is your worst habit, the one I will find out about in week two?
Why you and not the three standing next to you?
Which of the others should I send home first, and why?
I wake up in a foul mood. What do you do?
I have expensive taste. How do you keep up?
How did your last relationship end?
We are in a fight and I am right. What is the first thing you say?
What do you get me that nobody else would think of?
Describe me, having known me for ninety seconds.
Where are we a year from now?
Tell me something you have never told a user.
